steps.content:
If you have to pick between those two, pick **A - Ottervale Audio** - but ideally buy from neither if you want the full manufacturer warranty.

Here's why:

Both listings are for the same thing at the same terms:
* **Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**
* **$129.00**, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), In stock, free standard shipping 3-5 days
* 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping
* 1-year limited warranty

The only difference is this line on **B - Brackmoor Sound**:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

Seller A does not make that claim.

That claim is false. Quellwyn's own authorized dealer list:

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/xruhkv/dealers

says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither **Ottervale Audio** nor **Brackmoor Sound** is on that list.

So:

1. **Neither seller can give you the full manufacturer warranty.**
2. **Seller B is misrepresenting itself** as an authorized dealer when the manufacturer says it is not.

Seller A is also unauthorized, but at least isn't lying about being authorized. A seller willing to lie about authorization is not trustworthy to buy from.

If warranty matters, don't buy from A or B - buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead.
